critical_blockers.title: Literary & Foreign Language Stream Content Void
critical_blockers.description: Students registered in 'lettres_philo' or 'langues_etrangeres' encounter broken mission pages (404 / Mission introuvable) because zero learning bundles exist in domain content.
critical_blockers.impact: Renders the platform unusable for approximately 35% of the Algerian BAC student demographic.

critical_blockers.title: Remote Supabase Database Migration Desync
critical_blockers.description: Remote database has not executed migrations 013 to 017. Critical user progress, experiences, comments, and unlisted high school submissions drop into ephemeral localStorage or memory.
critical_blockers.impact: Data loss across devices, broken multi-device synchronization, and unreliable operations data.

critical_blockers.title: Synthetic Mock Options in Gestion & Économie
critical_blockers.description: 32 skill bundles in Gestion & Éco feature dummy distractors ('خيار بديل', 'الإجابة الصحيحة').
critical_blockers.impact: Destroys credibility and test validity for economics/accounting students.
critical_blockers.targetResolution: Author authentic distractors in domain content packages

critical_blockers.title: Duplicate Payment Orders in Operations Cockpit
critical_blockers.description: When a student submits a BaridiMob receipt, a race condition between local storage write and Supabase UUID return creates 2 distinct orders for the same payment.
critical_blockers.impact: Causes confusion, double-auditing, and potential accounting discrepancies for operators.
critical_blockers.targetResolution: Reconcile payment order creation to use a single authoritative UUID

critical_blockers.title: Edge Middleware Protection Hole
critical_blockers.description: src/middleware.ts matcher only covers /ops/:path*. All student routes (/dashboard, /mission, /exam) bypass Edge and rely on client hydration hooks.
critical_blockers.impact: Security bypass, layout flash, unnecessary server load.

important_improvements.title: Social Share Image Card Generator for Experiences
important_improvements.description: Students cannot generate a branded visual image card of their BAC tips for Instagram and WhatsApp sharing.
important_improvements.impact: Missed viral acquisition channel and word-of-mouth student growth.
important_improvements.targetResolution: Add HTML5 Canvas / SVG dynamic share card generator

important_improvements.title: Mobile Drawer Navigation Missing Experiences Link
important_improvements.description: The mobile navigation menu omits the link to /experiences.
important_improvements.impact: Decreased discovery and engagement for mobile smartphone users (85%+ of Algerian students).
important_improvements.targetResolution: Add route to mobile links array in Header component

important_improvements.title: Orphaned Legacy Onboarding Code (/onboarding)
important_improvements.description: 846 lines of obsolete prototype code still reside in the codebase at /onboarding.
important_improvements.impact: Technical debt, bundle size inflation, potential user confusion if accessed via direct URL.
important_improvements.targetResolution: Add 301 redirect to /auth/register or remove dead route

important_improvements.title: Lettres & Philo Diagnostic Pool Under-provisioning
important_improvements.description: Diagnostic test has only 3 questions for philosophy/literature.
important_improvements.impact: Inaccurate student gap profile and weak personalization.

important_improvements.title: Server Admin Client Missing SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
important_improvements.description: Server actions fall back to anon key and cannot bypass RLS when performing background administrative writes.
important_improvements.impact: Operational failures in audit logging and background user synchronization.
important_improvements.targetResolution: Set SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY in production deployment env

future_enhancements.title: Automated SMS / WhatsApp Payment Approval Notifications
future_enhancements.description: Students must currently refresh their account or check dashboard to see if their payment was approved.
future_enhancements.impact: Elevated support tickets and customer anxiety.

future_enhancements.title: Downloadable Error Lab PDF Revision Notebook
future_enhancements.description: Students cannot print a physical summary of their logged errors and personalized repair guides.
future_enhancements.impact: Algerian students who prefer physical revision notebooks cannot export their errors.

future_enhancements.title: Offline PWA Support for Intermittent Connectivity
future_enhancements.description: Missions and quizzes fail if internet drops during practice.
future_enhancements.impact: Friction for students in remote wilayas with unstable 4G/ADSL.
